idea-plugin.name: Copilot Agent Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Synchronizes shared GitHub Copilot agent and instruction files into your project.

After syncing, GitHub Copilot Chat will automatically discover the agents under Copilot Chat → Agent dropdown → Configure Agents.


Creates the following structure in your repository:

.github/
├── agents/
│   ├── tech-lead.agent.md
│   ├── java-spring-reviewer.agent.md
│   ├── angular-reviewer.agent.md
│   ├── security-reviewer.agent.md
│   └── test-engineer.agent.md
├── instructions/
│   ├── java.instructions.md
│   ├── spring-boot.instructions.md
│   ├── angular.instructions.md
│   ├── architecture.instructions.md
│   └── testing.instructions.md
└── copilot-instructions.md
AGENTS.md

Use Tools → Copilot Agent Sync → Sync Agent Files to write the files.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 2.0.0 — Java 25 and IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2 support; generated profiles now target Spring Boot 4.1 and Angular 22.
